scenario.label: Our biggest customer gave notice on Friday
scenario.brief: Meridian gave notice on Friday. They are 31% of revenue. Before we decide anything I want the three people who touch that account to write down what they knew and what they think happened, separately and before we meet.
scenario.theDecision: The signals were all there and each person held one: two missed QBRs, the champion left in July, and support tickets tripled in August. No one person saw all three. A right answer assembles the three into one timeline rather than asking who is to blame.

people.name: Ingrid Larsen
people.truth: She found out on Friday. She knew the champion had left but not that the QBRs were missed or that tickets had tripled. She had marked the account green in the last three forecasts.
people.manner: Shaken but disciplined. Wants the sequence.

people.name: Tobi Adeyinka
people.truth: Two quarterly reviews were cancelled by the customer, in June and September, and he rebooked neither. The champion, Sarah, left in July and her replacement never took a call. He reported the account as healthy because usage was flat, not falling.
people.manner: Defensive at first, then accurate. Has the dates once he stops explaining.

people.name: Hana Suzuki
people.truth: Meridian tickets went from about 9 a month to 31 in August, mostly about one broken export. The fix is still open. She flagged it in the support report which goes to a channel nobody reads.
people.manner: Calm and exact. Has the ticket numbers.

The champion leaving is a key detail. What is your best understanding of why Meridian's champion left?
I don't know why our champion left. I only knew that they did.
Who do you think would know why they left?
The account manager would be the person to ask about that.

You've pointed to the account manager as the person who would know. That is something we can pursue. You said you found out on Friday, just like everyone else. And you don't know why Meridian's champion left. So far, you've described what you don't yet know. What do you know first-hand?
